name: Summer Rotation and Vol Shock 2024
description: Mid-July through August 2024 saw a sharp reversal in the mega-cap AI trade as investors rotated into small-caps and value sectors, with IWM surging over 10% in July while QQQ declined. The Bank of Japan rate hike then triggered the August 5 carry-trade unwind, collapsing the rotation gains with a single-session VIX spike. Agents must navigate opposing signals — sector divergence, a vol shock, and recovery — across a 50-symbol universe spanning growth, defensives, and volatility instruments.
